author: Y SL
body:
Renovating a home is a big undertaking, with many decisions to make and details to consider. Having the right ID makes a world of difference, and I am truly grateful to have worked with Leon  who is responsible, reliable, patient and professional throughout the journey.

Leon took the time to understand my preferences, offered thoughtful design suggestions and helped bring my vision to life. Whenever i had questions or concerns, he was approachable and willing to work through them with me.  

I also valued the commitment to resolving issues and ensuring that things were properly taken care of.

To me, a good ID is not just someone who creates a beautiful design, but someone who listens, takes responsibility and genuinely cares about the end result.

Now that i have settled into my newly renovated home, i  am happy with the outcome and grateful for all the effort that went into making my home comfortable, functional and beautiful.

A big thank you to Leon and the M2D team for your hard work, dedication and patience. I truly appreciate everything you have done for me and would not hesitate to recommend M2D to anyone looking for a reliable and professional team for their home renovation.

author: Faiz Mohd
body:
I knew of M2D from a family member who had previously engaged them. I liked how said family member’s home had turned out, and so decided to go with M2D for mine (which is a 3-room resale flat). I am very glad I did, as it was truly a pleasant and stress-free journey from start to end. 

The whole process began with an initial consultation with Leon. He would walk you through an overview of what the entire reno undertaking entails, the expected timelines, and the estimated costs. Once the preliminary quotation is completed and the client is ready to commit, only then will you make the first deposit for the full works to go ahead. At all times, you would have clarity of what is happening/is going to happen next, and Leon is always ready to clarify if you have any queries or uncertainties.

ID - Identifying a credible ID and navigating through the whole reno process can be quite an intimidating experience for someone with zero knowledge in this area, so I was very glad to have Leon at the helm. Leon was very pleasant to work with - he was never pushy or overbearing, but rather provided his ideas and suggestions in a considered and measured manner which exudes the confidence of someone who knows his stuff well. I don’t speak design, but Leon was somehow able to read what I had in mind, which was something simple and not too over-the-top, but yet tasteful and aesthetically pleasing. I also appreciated his patience in explaining why certain things are placed in certain places or in a certain way, and suggesting alternatives that would work just as well without the client incurring unnecessary expenses. 

Workmanship - The quality of the carpentry is very satisfying; the drawers and swing doors, for instance, are thick and sturdy. It is also very helpful that M2D has their own trusted go-to vendors for certain fixtures (such as lights, aircon, sanitary wares, etc) whom I understand they work with very well and provide after-sales services, which eliminates the need for the client to source for these things on their own.

Transparency - M2D is upfront about costs. The quotation provided upon confirmation covers everything that could possibly be done within the agreed scheme of work (barring costs which cannot be specified in advance, such as electrical works or window works - even so, the final costs for mine was not far off from the quotation). Leon was also transparent about the timelines and whether they would be able to deliver should the client have a hard deadline. Overall, mine took approximately just under 12 weeks from the start of reno to handover.

All in all, I really have got no complaints. Having M2D handle my reno took a huge chunk of mental load off my headspace, and I’d have no qualms recommending them to others.

author: vikram_vijayakumar
body:
We engaged Benjamin from M2D to renovate our BTO and couldn’t be happier with the result. As first time home owners, it was re assuring to have Benjamin handle our renovation as he was always responsive throughout the whole process from even before we engaged him till the end. 

Benjamin was resourceful and gave us great suggestions to guide us along. We were anticipating the usual renovation hiccups and delays but we were fortunate to have a smooth experience. In fact he took less than 2 months to finish our project, and still showed great attention to detail and fine workmanship.

Our interactions with his team members was always pleasant and professional. 

We are more than happy to recommend engaging Benjamin and his team!

author: dorothy_yu
body:
Prior to my house renovation, I scoured through 5 different designer firms. 

Ben stood out from the rest in his ability to pull together my fragmented concepts and was able to patiently guide my understanding on why certain ideas may not work practically.

The other designers I’ve met either gave me a cookie cutter design or was centred only on design features which were impractical.

Ben was willing to work very closely with me in trying out new ideas, gadgets and decor items that I purchased on my own and was able to incorporated them into the design. 

He has a keen eye for detail and ensures that every corner, jutting lines and electrical trunking were well hidden, and making every part of the design intentional. 

The other designers whom I’ve met falls on either side of the spectrum, ie not wanting to go out of their comfort zones to work on fresh ideas, or blindly agreeing to my every whim and not experienced enough to point out possible pitfalls.

I’ll highly recommend Ben as he’s able to bring practicality into innovative designs. He’s experienced to be able to constructively challenge some of my long wish-list and is willing to work with me to find suitable solutions together.

If you want a worry-free experience, you are in good hands with Ben.

author: Anthony Ng
body:
When I first got my 2-room BTO, I was worried about its unconventional layout—an open kitchen right in the center and a service yard positioned at the entrance. In the hands of an ordinary interior designer, my home could have easily ended up looking like just another cookie-cutter unit with little thought given to maximizing space and functionality. But engaging Leon turned out to be the best decision I made for my renovation.

From the start, Leon impressed me with his creativity and problem-solving skills. He took the time to understand my lifestyle, preferences, and needs before coming up with a unique and well-thought-out design. Not only did he make my space look stunning, but he also ensured that every element served a functional purpose. His ability to balance aesthetics and practicality is truly remarkable.

What stood out most was his flexibility and willingness to listen. He was open to suggestions and adaptable to new ideas while offering expert guidance based on his experience. Throughout the renovation process, he remained patient, professional, and dedicated to achieving the best possible outcome. His meticulous attention to detail and commitment to quality ensured that everything was executed to perfection.

Leon is the kind of interior designer who under-promises but over-delivers. He doesn't just follow trends—he creates designs that are timeless, thoughtful, and tailored to the homeowner. The entire renovation process was smooth, and any challenges that arose were handled efficiently without compromising on quality.

I don’t give out praise easily, but I can confidently say that Leon and his exceptional team go above and beyond to deliver outstanding results. If you’re looking for an interior designer who truly cares about your home and will make it stand out from the rest, look no further. I highly recommend Leon to anyone who wants a home that is not just beautiful but also uniquely theirs.

author: Hendra To
body:

author: terry_lee
body: If you have high expectations for quality, craftsmanship, and a team committed to delivering results on time, M2D is the firm to trust. When I bought my dream home, I knew it was my forever home, and I wanted nothing less than the best to transform it into a space of elegance, style, and perfection. Having moved homes every few years, this was the one where I would finally settle, and I wanted to ensure the renovation was nothing short of amazing. I decided to invest in a top-tier renovation, and after shortlisting a few reputable ID firms, the turning point came when my partner showed me a beautiful fluted glass panel door from M2D. It was love at first sight. Unfortunately, the other firms couldn’t guarantee they could source the exact door, which disappointed me. That’s when we decided to reach out to M2D directly. Benjamin, the owner, personally guided us through the entire process. I was surprised by how young he was, but his warm personality and confident yet humble demeanor immediately put me at ease. He genuinely listened to my vision, was responsive to my concerns, and assured me that he could deliver within the tight 11-week timeline. Given the scope of work, which included complete flooring hacking, wall hacking and ceiling work, and the removal of old, unsightly metal grilles on the windows. It was an ambitious task, but Benjamin was the only one who assured me he could meet the deadline. The journey wasn’t without its bumps, but what truly stood out was Benjamin's unwavering commitment to delivering on time. Even with unexpected setbacks, Benjamin and his team worked tirelessly to resolve every issue and kept pushing forward to ensure the job was done right. They took on the full scope of work, including the flooring hacking across the entire house, which was no small feat. The quality of the workmanship was impressive, and it was clear that Benjamin's team shared his dedication to getting everything perfect. While the overall experience was positive, there were moments where I felt communication could have been improved. On a few occasions, design decisions were made without prior consultation, and I would have preferred a more proactive discussion about these changes, as I had envisioned certain details differently. That being said, Benjamin always worked to resolve any issues that came up, and I ultimately felt very satisfied with the outcome. The pricing was on the higher end, and the 3D renderings didn’t quite match my expectations, but these were minor aspects of the grand scheme of the project. What truly mattered to me was that Benjamin kept his word and delivered a beautiful home on time. In the end, the results exceeded my expectations. The house feels like a dream, and I’m extremely happy with the final design. I’m grateful to Benjamin and his team for all their hard work, and I highly recommend M2D to anyone looking for a reliable, skilled, and committed interior design team. With Benjamin leading the way, you can trust that your dream home will come to life with care and precision.
